proposed_comments.title: Expose independent sample-validity flags (1/17)
proposed_comments.body:
### Expose independent sample-validity flags (1/17)

**Severity:** `medium`

When a counter sample is missing, its previous value can look current. This member adds a validity flag beside each used-memory value in the result returned to the widget; apply all 17 suggestions together so each unavailable metric renders as `--`, not as measured zero.

```suggestion
    internal readonly record struct MemoryInfo(
        ulong DedicatedUsed,
        ulong DedicatedTotal,
        bool DedicatedAvailable,
        ulong SharedUsed,
        ulong SharedTotal,
        bool SharedAvailable);
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream source/caller trace directly shows retained bytes crossing a missing sample without a validity state; the proposed member is part of the tested availability-state design.
